[[File:Neuer.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The ''Neuer'' landing on Mala]]
The '''''Neuer''''' was a [[Sentinel-class landing craft/Legends|''Sentinel''-class landing craft]] that was used by the [[Fel Empire]] around [[139 ABY]]. During the [[Battle of the Floating World]], it was used to evacuate wounded and dying [[Imperial Knight]]s. Later, the shuttle was used to evacuate the wounded [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Empress]] [[Marasiah Fel]], who had been attacked by the rogue [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Darth Wredd]].
